mapping_evidence.method: IODeviceTree /cpus: each cpuN logical-cpu-id with cluster-type E (ids 0-3, logical-cluster-id 0) or P (ids 4-7 cluster 1, 8-11 cluster 2); corroborated by host_processor_info per-index busy deltas: QOS_CLASS_BACKGROUND spin loads only indices 0-3, QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE spin loads indices 4-7; counts equal hw.perflevel0.logicalcpu=8 (Performance) and hw.perflevel1.logicalcpu=4 (Efficiency)
